# Bugs

One file per bug, `BUG-001-short-name.md`, created by `/bug-report` from `_template-bug.md`. If the team uses
an issue tracker, the file holds the draft and the tracker link; the tracker stays the source of truth for
status.

Statuses: New → Confirmed → In progress → Fixed → Verified → Closed (or Rejected / Duplicate).
